properties.name: The path the coherence loop relies on to interrupt an agent is proven to interrupt one
properties.statement: The Stop-hook nudge and the read-side loop_hint are the only mechanisms that make the loop self-correcting, and nothing proves they reach a live agent: the existing suite tests the nudge script given its inputs, not that the hook is installed and fires. Prove the path end to end in a real session, and give it a backstop for when it is absent — a mechanism relied on to interrupt you is worthless until observed doing so.
